def Rq(q):
 w,x,y,z=q; return np.array([[1-2*(y*y+z*z),2*(x*y-z*w),2*(x*z+y*w)],[2*(x*y+z*w),1-2*(x*x+z*z),2*(y*z-x*w)],[2*(x*z-y*w),2*(y*z+x*w),1-2*(x*x+y*y)]])
def so3log(R):
 c=np.clip((np.trace(R)-1)/2,-1,1); a=np.arccos(c)
 if a<1e-8:return np.zeros(3)
 return a/(2*np.sin(a))*np.array([R[2,1]-R[1,2],R[0,2]-R[2,0],R[1,0]-R[0,1]])
def ik(pos,qgoal,maxit=200):
 q=d.qpos[qadr].copy(); jp=np.zeros((3,m.nv)); jr=np.zeros((3,m.nv))
 for it in range(maxit):
  d.qpos[qadr]=q; mujoco.mj_forward(m,d)
  p=d.xpos[body].copy(); R= d.xmat[body].reshape(3,3).copy(); ep=pos-p; er=so3log(qgoal@R.T)
  e=np.r_[ep,er]
  if np.linalg.norm(ep)<.001 and np.linalg.norm(er)<.01: break
  mujoco.mj_jacBody(m,d,jp,jr,body)
  J=np.vstack([jp[:,s._jv[:7]],jr[:,s._jv[:7]]])
  # orientation weighted in meters-ish 8cm/radian
  W=np.diag([1,1,1,.08,.08,.08]); JW=W@J; ew=W@e
  dq=JW.T@np.linalg.solve(JW@JW.T+np.eye(6)*1e-4,ew)
  # constrain max each iteration
  dq=np.clip(dq,-.04,.04); q=np.clip(q+dq,s.lower[:7],s.upper[:7])
 print('ik it',it,'err',np.linalg.norm(ep),np.linalg.norm(er),'q',q)
 return q
